messages:
morgan: Quick FYI — I noticed two things on the Localization & Regions doc: the region availability table doesn't call out the HK legal footnote for on‑prem, and the JS SDK snippet still uses `region:` instead of the `endpoint` param for private installs. Small risk: readers might assume residency covers all deployment modes. PR incoming.

anya: thanks — can you paste the exact lines? want to include the change in the release notes.

morgan: pasted snippet from the page: "Data residency applies to Hosted & Dedicated — for Private deployments, data locality is customer-controlled (see legal footnote 3)." but the HK row doesn't link to footnote 3. Also current JS snippet is:

```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'ap-southeast-1' })
```

should be:

```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, endpoint: 'https://private-console.myorg.redwood' })
```

liam: +1 on swapping to endpoint. Also the curl example for embeddings still posts to the hosted host without host override; that will confuse folks using Private. I'll add a Host + PRIVATE_HOST example. :eyes:

morgan: here's the curl tweak I propose so people see the pattern clearly:

```bash
curl -X POST "$PRIVATE_HOST/v1/embeddings" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"text-embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```

jun: pinging legal@ for HK footnote language. @docs-bot can you open a PR draft with these three changes (table footnote, JS snippet, curl host) and assign to @anya & @liam for review?

docs-bot: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421 — assigned to @anya @liam. (automated)

anya: I'll take the JS snippet + inline example updates and coordinate with legal for wording. liam can you handle curl + table wording? I can also add a short note in the page explaining the difference between Hosted/Dedicated vs Private for residency.

liam: on it. I'll also run a quick grep across /docs for `region:` usage and create a follow-up issue if anything else pops up.

morgan: thanks all. goal: ship this patch by EOD tomorrow. If legal delays HK wording, we can ship the snippets and add a TODO/placeholder callout linking the PR to the legal issue.

anya: noted. I'll add a short changelog entry and a small migration note in the SDK snippets section so users upgrading from `region` see the mapping.

morgan: perfect — leaving the rest to you. I dropped a short comment in the PR with the sample Host header and the HK footnote request.
